# Mavri

> Self-hosted invoicing and quotes by NodeDR (Go, SQLite): document currencies, payments, PDF and XML e-invoice exports, reminders, recurring invoices, store-order import, REST API with OpenAPI, signed webhooks and an MCP server with approval gates. Requires running your own instance. Not a tax filing service.
